title: Leading and Managing Change
overview: This course serves as an ideal introduction for participants and the organizations they represent to the essential topics of change and change management. It provides valuable insights into a critical concern for modern businesses, equipping attendees with the knowledge and skills to navigate and manage change effectively.
audience: This course is designed for change managers, business process improvement specialists, members of change management teams, coordinators of reorganizations and mergers, implementers of organizational change, and any business professionals interested in mastering the art of managing change.
methodology: The course leverages real-life business change scenarios and initiatives, allowing participants to apply the knowledge and techniques discussed throughout the sessions in practical, hands-on ways.
competencies: Evaluating the costs associated with change
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Explain the perspectives of leadership and management on change
Analyze change and develop effective strategies and plans to manage it
Handle resistance to change and understand the emotions tied to it
Design and discuss communication strategies that accelerate change
Gain insights into corporate cultures and understand how they impact change initiatives
